# License Radar

One place to track practice renewal dates.

License Radar helps a practice keep its credential records, renewal dates and renewal progress together. Authorized practice members can review records and reminder history after signing in.

The personal Gmail pilot sends renewal reminders from the operator's authorized Gmail account to the same approved account. Google access is used to verify the sender and send reminder emails. License Radar does not request permission to read your inbox.

Gmail acceptance is shown as accepted, with delivery unconfirmed. The Gmail pilot does not automatically resend reminders or check mailbox delivery.

Links: Sign in → `/login`; Privacy → `/privacy`.

# Privacy

Updated October 15, 2026. This notice describes the License Radar personal pilot and its Gmail reminder integration.

## Information we use

License Radar stores the email used to sign in, practice membership and the credential and renewal information entered by authorized members. Reminder history records who a reminder was intended for, its scheduling and submission status, and provider message identifiers.

Session cookies keep you signed in to the application.

For the Gmail integration, Google provides the authorized account's email, verified-email status and account identifier. The operator stores OAuth credentials so the server can send reminders without asking for a Google password. License Radar requests sending and basic identity permissions. It does not request permission to read the inbox, contacts, existing messages or attachments.

## How information is used and shared

Google account information is used to verify the authorized sender. The server sends reminder content and its approved recipient address to Google to submit email through Gmail. The personal pilot restricts sending to the same approved Gmail account.

Vercel hosts the application and protected server configuration. Supabase stores sign-in, practice and reminder records. These services process information needed to run the app. The application does not sell Google user data, use it for advertising, or send it to AI models for training. Access to private application records is restricted to authorized practice members and operators maintaining the service.

## Storage and retention

Gmail credentials are kept in protected server configuration and private operator setup files; they are not sent to the browser. Access tokens are held temporarily during a reminder-worker run. The database keeps account identity binding and reminder history. This describes the application's controls and is not a guarantee against every security risk.

Practice records and reminder history remain until removed by the operator. Archiving a record does not delete its reminder history. Removing Google's authorization stops future authorized sends but does not delete existing app records or retract email already submitted to Gmail. Stored setup credentials must also be removed by the operator when disconnecting the integration.

## Your choices and contact

You can turn off reminder email in the app. The operator can disable Gmail sending and its scheduler. You can remove License Radar's Google access from your Google Account connections at `https://myaccount.google.com/connections`.

For questions or a request to remove stored information, contact **arsen.yere1@gmail.com**. Requests are handled by the operator; the pilot does not offer an automated data-deletion screen.

Links: About License Radar → `/about`; Sign in → `/login`.
